The '''Spiverelda''' was a name given by certain [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] species&mdash;in particular the [[Harch/Legends|Harch]] and some [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]]&mdash;for the government of [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] and its colonies in the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]].

==History==
Historically a violent, turbulent region characterised by despotism, in the [[100 BBY/Legends|last century]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] various Andoan colony worlds attempted to declare independence from the Spiverelda, forming the [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|Andoan Free Colonies]]. Supported by the Harch, the Spiverelda fought the Free Colonies in the [[Andoan Wars/Legends|Andoan Wars]] of [[57 BBY/Legends|57]]&ndash;[[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]]. The Spiverelda almost achieved victory until their ruthless tactics encouraged the Galactic Republic to intervene, separating the two sides and [[Ando Demilitarization Observation Group|demilitarizing]] the sector.

This sudden reversal of fortunes radicalized the Spiveralda's leadership: more than a decade later during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Ando became one of the first worlds to [[Ando separation|secede]] from the Republic and join [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
